meta.description: Privacy Policy for E&P Systems. Learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal data.

intro.title: 1. Introduction & Company Information
intro.text: E&P Systems, based in Sofia, Bulgaria, is committed to protecting your privacy and personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you visit our website or use our services, in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

dataCollect.title: 2. Data We Collect
dataCollect.text: We collect the following types of personal data:

items.0: Contact information (name, email address, phone number) submitted through our contact form
items.1: Analytics data collected through cookies (browsing behavior, pages visited, device information)
items.2: Technical data (IP address, browser type, operating system) for website functionality

items.0: Responding to your inquiries and providing requested information about our services
items.1: Improving our website experience and services based on analytics data
items.2: Communicating with you about projects and services you have expressed interest in

cookies.title: 4. Cookies Policy
cookies.text: Our website uses the following types of cookies:

items.0: Essential cookies: Required for basic website functionality (e.g., cookie consent preferences)
items.1: Analytics cookies: Help us understand how visitors interact with our website to improve the user experience

cookies.optOut: You can manage your cookie preferences at any time using the cookie consent banner. You can also disable cookies through your browser settings, though this may affect website functionality.

items.0: Contact form inquiries are retained for up to 2 years, then securely deleted
items.1: Analytics data is aggregated and anonymized, and does not contain personally identifiable information

gdpr.title: 6. Your Rights Under GDPR
gdpr.text: As a data subject under the GDPR, you have the following rights:

items.0: Right of access: Request a copy of your personal data we hold
items.1: Right to rectification: Request correction of inaccurate personal data
items.2: Right to erasure: Request deletion of your personal data
items.3: Right to data portability: Request your data in a structured, machine-readable format

contact.text: To exercise any of your rights or for questions about our data practices, contact us at:

story.heading: Our Story
story.p1: E&P Systems was founded in Sofia, Bulgaria with a single mission: bring engineering-grade software solutions to small and medium businesses. We combine deep technical expertise in full-stack development, SEO, and AI automation with a results-first mentality.
story.p2: We believe every business deserves the same quality of digital tools that enterprise companies take for granted. That's why we focus on building solutions that are not just functional, but fast, scalable, and designed to drive real growth.
story.p3: From custom web applications and e-commerce platforms to AI-powered automation and data-driven SEO, we deliver end-to-end digital solutions that help our clients compete and win in the digital landscape.

precision.title: Engineering Precision
precision.description: Every line of code, every strategy, every decision is grounded in data and best practices. We don't guess — we measure, test, and deliver.

speed.title: Speed & Efficiency
speed.description: We move fast without cutting corners. Our streamlined processes and modern tech stack mean your project goes from idea to launch in record time.

transparency.title: Full Transparency
transparency.description: No black boxes. You'll always know what we're doing, why we're doing it, and how it impacts your bottom line. We're partners, not vendors.
